name: MolCraft
summary:
MolCraft is a molecule-building game for Meta Quest. Take atoms from the tray and bond them together. Each element forms as many bonds as its valence allows, and the structure arranges itself in 3D as you build.

BUILD WHAT VALENCE ALLOWS
There is no fixed list of recipes: two atoms can bond whenever both have a free valence. Single and multiple bonds, rings, fused rings and some ions can be built.

FIND OUT WHAT YOU MADE
When a structure is complete, MolCraft identifies it. Names for over 10,000 compounds
